messages:
Rae: Quick sync: usability pass on the condensed API key creation modal. Noticed a few UX & accessibility frictions. Dropping consolidated notes here.

Priya: Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/cred-compact-designs (frames 2-4). Main callouts: primary CTA phrasing, warning visibility, and missing keyboard focus indicators.

Eli: The perms dropdown currently defaults to `Project:write`. Recommend defaulting to `Project:read` to follow least-privilege principle. Also add a one-line helper under the selector: "Least privilege limits impact if a key is leaked."

Sam: Users misread "Create & Download" as an automatic download. To avoid surprise, change primary to "Create key" (reveals secret) and provide an explicit "Download" option or a follow-up download CTA in the success UI.

Nora: Security feedback: the empty credentials illustration feels too casual. Swap to a neutral icon and add a one-line policy hint: "Rotate keys regularly. Soft-delete available for 14 days."

A11yBot: Automated audit: warning banner contrast ratio 3.4:1 (fails AA for small text). Also secret reveal lacks `aria-live` so SR users aren't notified when a secret appears.

Rae: Suggested microcopy: primary = "Create key"; toast = "Key created — copy or download now." Inline helper under permissions: "This key grants access to project resources. Choose the minimum scope."

Priya: Found tab-order bug: after tabbing out of permissions focus jumps to the modal close before the secret reveal toggle. Fix order to: permissions -> reveal toggle -> action buttons. Add visible focus style (`outline: 2px solid var(--focus)`) and ensure non-color-dependent indicators.

Eli: Rotate modal clarity: update copy to say "The previous key is revoked immediately; you can recover it within 14 days via soft-delete." Link to docs: /docs/keys#rotation.

Sam: For undo, include an undo action in the toast with a 14s TTL. Dev example: {"toast":"Key rotated","actions":[{"label":"Undo","id":"undo-rotate"}],"ttl_ms":14000}. Keep undo accessible by keyboard.

Nora: Move the red high-risk warning above the perms selector so it's seen before selection. Add a small header: "⚠️ High-risk scope" and a short impact statement.

Rae: a11y details: add `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` to the secret container and ensure the reveal button toggles `aria-expanded`.

Priya: I'll update Figma with helper copy, tab order, and focus styles today.

Eli: I'll draft rotate copy and the recovery docs blurb.

Sam: I'll split create vs download in the component and add the undo toast.

Nora: I'll swap the illustration and add the rotation note to the empty state.

Rae: Owners: Priya (design), Eli (copy & docs), Sam (component), Nora (empty state). I'll file an a11y bug for contrast & aria-live.

A11yBot: Issue filed: PROD-5879 — "Credential modal: contrast and aria-live fixes".

Rae: Thanks all. If anything blocks, flag it and we'll prioritize in sprint planning.
